title: polystichum lacerum
intro: Polystichum lacerum, commonly known as the variable-leafed fern, is a species of fern that belongs to the family Dryopteridaceae. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Polystichum lacerum are attributed to its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory and antioxidant, which may help to soothe and protect the body. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
